record_scope_definition: Each function record hashes its complete original assembly range; this pins source evidence, not complete source reconstruction or live runtime integration. The current adapter coverage and caller-owned state limits are described in NOTES.md.
source_reconstruction_scope: Bounded ordinary Random stream slot-index selection for an uncached non-player Character template with a positive CharInfoSize, using the existing source-differential-tested RNG kernel and caller-provided stream state.
caller_facts: Character::SafeGetCharPropsId uses Random::s_seed and debug counter index 0 directly in its uncached non-player template branch; it does not use s_syncedSeed.
The uncached branch draws only if CharInfoSize is nonzero. With zero slots it does not advance a seed or debug counter.
For a positive slot count, the branch applies the ordinary-stream LCG once, reduces by CharInfoSize, increments the ordinary counter once, and uses the result as the ordered CharInfo slot index.
The existing port/random kernel carries two independent caller-owned seed/counter streams. Its 768 comparisons against original Random::GetRandom report zero mismatches.
GSInit::Update state 13 and Level::Unload explicitly set s_seed from glitch::os::Timer::getRealTime() and s_syncedSeed to zero; those time/order inputs remain outside this adapter.
The Random.cpp static initializer resets diagnostic counters but does not set the ordinary or synchronized game seeds.
unsupported: No per-actor original slot is claimed without the timer seed and every preceding ordinary-stream draw/construction-order dependency.
The adapter does not own, seed, reset, or globalize the random streams; caller supplies and retains their state.
Cached property-ID early return, player/savegame selection, actor construction, template-to-CharacterTable mapping, and property/class resolution are separate paths or modules.
Negative slot counts are rejected as malformed adapter input; only the observed empty and positive template-count branches are supported.
This is not the independent port/game-data CombatRandom stream and does not alter combat RNG semantics.

functions.port_coverage: the ordinary/synchronized two-stream LCG is implemented in existing port/random; this adapter selects ordinary stream via sync=0
adapter reproduces only the positive-count, uncached non-player slot-index draw and no-alternatives no-draw boundary; no Character cache/player path is implemented
seed-ownership evidence only: initialization state 13 assigns the ordinary seed from Timer::getRealTime and zeros the synchronized seed
seed-ownership evidence only: unload reseeds ordinary stream from Timer::getRealTime and zeros synchronized seed
seed-ownership boundary evidence only: explicitly zeros both debug counters, not the game seed values
